text: I bought Aurora X2, they're good for the price. 149. The battery life on one charge is nearly 30 hours, but I've been using them for 2 or 3 days per charge, so I'm happy there. The sound is pretty good. Bass is deep, resonant and the highs are crisp. The noise cancellation, this works remarkably well. I'm on the commute every day and it blocks out ambient noise pretty effectively. However, the cushions can become uncomfortable if you are listening for hours. The app is the only real problem. The app sometimes disconnects, which is annoying. Not saying that I would buy them again but I recommend for anyone. Reliable.
